name: Braced Stand
description: Set the feet and lock the will so a heavy blow lands on a body that refuses to give ground.

name: Spark Strike
description: Answer a hit at once with a short straight blow that carries a sudden burst of resolve.

name: Steadying Breath
description: Slow the breath of the user or a shaken ally until trembling hands go still and qi runs even again.

name: Held Forearm
description: Hold the forearm firm and turn a glancing blow off the body without flinching back.

name: Spark Advance
description: Push forward through the follow-through of a blow to close on the foe before fear can slow the feet.

name: Pain Mark
description: Take stock of every hurt and the reserve left in the user so the will is spent only where it counts.

name: Even Breath
description: Draw long even breaths in time with an ally so both settle and fatigue stops dragging at the limbs.

name: Resolve Palm
description: Strike with the open palm and let a surge of resolve carry the blow past hesitation.

name: Rooted Knee
description: Bend the knees and sink the will into the floor so a shove cannot move the body.

name: Calm Eye
description: Fix the gaze and read the fear or fury of a foe from the set of the shoulders and the rhythm of the breath.

name: Resolve Jab
description: Snap a quick straight jab and repeat it at once if it lands driven by a refusal to be pushed back.

name: Unflinching Meet
description: Meet an incoming strike with a firm forearm so the rhythm of the attacker breaks on a body that did not flinch.

name: Resolute Advance
description: Take one weighted step forward after taking a hit to keep the foe from winning back the space.

name: Keel Stance
description: Hold a low wide stance with qi sunk into the legs so pushing and pulling attacks find no purchase.

name: Dogged Fist
description: Drive a plain fist forward again and again with the will set on one point until the guard gives.

name: Second Wind
description: Call up a hidden reserve of effort when breath runs short so the user or an ally fights on with clear limbs.

name: Shoulder Roll
description: Roll the shoulder under a blow and spend its force on turning rather than on pain.

name: Quick Rise
description: Rise from a knee or a fall in one push and land ready with the will already set.

name: Quiet Coal
description: Bank a steady glow of will in the belly of an ally or the self so fatigue and fear stay low.

name: Banked Fist
description: Release a held glow of will through a single fist so the blow lands with more than the arm alone.

name: Pain Ward
description: Push the sting of a fresh wound to the edge of attention so the guard stays whole.

name: Glow Reading
description: Feel the warmth of will in a nearby ally and judge how much strength they still hold.

name: Coal Slide
description: Slide low under a sweeping blow and come up with the glow of will unbroken.

name: Smoulder Jab
description: Jab with slow built heat behind it so each repeat lands harder than the one before.

name: Unbowed Back
description: Straighten the spine under a crushing blow and let the force pass down through braced legs.

name: Even Gaze
description: Hold the eyes level and read the intent of a foe before the first move is made.

name: Proud Fist
description: Throw a straight fist from an upright stance with the chin high and the will behind the knuckles.

name: Lifting Word
description: Speak a plain word and touch a slumped ally with a thread of qi so the shoulders square and strength returns.

name: Square Shoulder
description: Turn the squared shoulder into a blow so it slides off the frame and out of line.

name: Hard Elbow
description: Drive the point of the elbow into the foe's ribs at the moment the foe leans in.

name: Step Through
description: Walk straight through the space a foe has just struck at and take the line toward the foe's centre.

name: Backbone Hold
description: Keep the whole frame upright for a long while under a steady pressing weight without sagging.

name: Courage Hold
description: Hold a hand to the chest of a frightened ally and lend a steady beat of will until the shaking stops.

name: Stilled Hands
description: Still the trembling hands of the user so the next strike or the next stitch lands true.

name: Nerve Strike
description: Strike with a cold clear mind and no flinch so the blow goes exactly where it was aimed.

name: Bared Guard
description: Spread the arms and take a blow on the front of the body without turning away from it.

name: Brave Step
description: Step toward the danger instead of away from it and take the first move of the exchange.

name: Fear Mark
description: Notice where fear is rising in the body of the user or a foe and name it before it takes the legs.

name: Cinder Pulse
description: Send a small rhythmic pulse of will through an ally's chest to keep breath and heartbeat level.

name: Pulse Strike
description: Time a strike to the beat of the heart so the blow lands with the full surge of the pulse.

name: Cinder Guard
description: Cover the chest with a dull red skin of will that turns away a light blade or a thrown stone.

name: Heartbeat Count
description: Count the heartbeats of a foe in a clinch to judge how tired the foe is and how soon the foe will break.

name: Cinder Dash
description: Burst into a short sprint on a spark of will and stop dead at the end of it with the balance whole.

name: Thrum Jab
description: Throw a jab that hums along the arm with stored will and rattles the guard it hits.

name: Pulse Turn
description: Turn aside a blow at the very beat of its arrival by moving the hip a hand's width.

name: Bare Mettle
description: Take a blow on the braced frame with no trick at all and stay on the feet through plain stubbornness.

name: Mettle Strike
description: Hit hard and straight with a fist that has been drilled until it needs no thought.

name: Trial Breath
description: Breathe through a long hard drill alongside an ally so both keep the pace past the point of wanting to stop.

name: Weight Read
description: Feel how much force a blow carries by the first touch and judge how much will it will cost to hold.

name: Mettle Step
description: Advance a pace with the whole body behind the lead foot and keep the next pace ready.

name: Blunt Answer
description: Return a hard blow with a plain harder one aimed at the same spot.

name: Hard Hold
description: Clamp a foe's wrist in a stubborn grip so the foe's strike dies half thrown.
